basis: Union Pacific’s October 19 earnings release was the earliest qualifying disclosure found. Its consolidated income statement reported total operating revenues of $5,941 million for the three months ended September 30, 2023, against $6,566 million for the same quarter of 2022. That was a 9.52% decline and $296.7 million below the $6,237.7 million threshold. Both figures include freight and other revenues on the same reported basis.

coverage.detail: April 20, Q1 earnings release. Union Pacific maintained full-year guidance on volume growth relative to industrial production, pricing, operating ratio and capital allocation. It gave no Q3 consolidated revenue figure or range.
June 13, Wells Fargo conference update. Management disclosed labor costs, a full-year operating ratio expected to exceed the 2022 level and a Q2 tax benefit. None established a Q3 revenue ceiling.

July 26, Q2 earnings release and call. The reported 5% revenue decline applied to Q2. The forward outlook placed full-year volume growth below forecast industrial production growth of 0.1% and put second-half labor expense from new agreements at $50–70 million. The call discussed Q3 margins and volume trends without giving a numerical ceiling for Q3 total revenue.
July 26, separate 8-K exhibit. Union Pacific announced Jim Vena’s appointment as CEO and other leadership changes. It supplied no Q3 sales outlook.
The companion July 26 exhibit announced two director appointments and a board committee change.
August 11, Form 8-K. The disclosure concerned outgoing CEO Lance Fritz’s transition agreement and compensation.
September 6, TD Cowen conference pitchbook. The forward-looking operating discussion covered volume by market and second-half demand. It gave no Q3 consolidated revenue range.

September 12, Morgan Stanley Laguna conference, announced September 5. Management discussed the absence of the usual Q2-to-Q3 seasonal volume increase and the second-half fuel effect on earnings per share. Neither remark quantified Q3 total operating revenues.
September 21, earnings calendar notice. Union Pacific scheduled its Q3 results for October 19 at 7:45 a.m. Eastern and the call for 8:45 a.m. The notice contained no preliminary results.
September 29, Form 8-K. The disclosure concerned board membership and committee assignments.

October 19, Q3 earnings release, Exhibit 99.1. The three-month consolidated table gives $5,545 million of freight revenue plus $396 million of other revenue, totaling $5,941 million, with $6,566 million in the prior-year comparison column.

publication_date_evidence: Union Pacific’s Q3 results release carries an Omaha dateline of October 19, 2023 and states that the company reported its results that day. Its September 21 notice independently identifies October 19 as the public release date.
